name: Rule Scene
description: THE WORKHORSE. A pictogram room (bedroom, hallway, front door, street...) with the cast in it; something happens (door opens, knock, lights flicker, dog hides, visitor at the window...) on its spoken word, then a bold headline stamp slams onto the key word with a red arrow or ring on the thing that matters. Use for most rules, situations and story beats.

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

time.description: Optional clock stamp in the corner, e.g. "2:00 AM", "3:33 AM".

id.description: Cast id: you (plain figure, the viewer), mom (dress + bun), dad (cap, broad), kid (small), grandma (dress, cane), friend (backwards cap), stranger (hat + coat), visitor (too tall, long arms, white eyes, wide smile: the threat), dog, cat, owl, crow. Keep the same cast across the video.

pose.description: Starting pose (people): stand, sit, sit-bed, sleep, lie, look, listen, hide, scared, hands-up, phone, hush, cover-ears, cover-eyes, flashlight, stop, wave, point, knock, reach, peek, crouch, pray. Pets: stand, sit, lie, hide, alert, stare, sleep, growl.

slot.description: Which standing spot of the room to use (0 = main spot, 1, 2). Default: in order.

characters.description: Who is in the room, 1-3 entries (first one is the protagonist). Default: you.

action.description: What happens, on actionKeyword (or about 30 % in): door-opens, door-slams, knock, lights-flicker, lights-out, phone-rings, curtains-close, curtains-open, visitor-at-door, visitor-at-window, eyes-in-the-dark (dark mode), dog-hides, dog-stares, dog-growls, tv-static (living-room), car-arrives (street), bus-arrives (bus-stop), clock-strikes, footsteps, run, hide, lamp-on, lamp-off, owl-watches, poster.

actionKeyword.description: Spoken word the action lands on (e.g. "knock", "opens").

stamp.description: The headline stamp, 1-6 words, e.g. "DON'T *OPEN* IT", "CHECK THE *DATE*". Star the key word.

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

stampColor.description: Stamp colouring: mixed = black blocks + red key word (default); red = all red; ink = all black; yellow = warning yellow blocks.

stampPos.description: Where the stamp lands (default upper / top in portrait).

arrowTo.description: What the red arrow points at after the stamp: an object in the room (door, window, bed, clock, phone, lamp, tv, car, poster...), "character", "pet" or "action" (the thing that just happened). Default: a red ring around the action.

ring.description: Use a red ring instead of an arrow on arrowTo.

triangle.description: Show a warning triangle with the stamp.

caption.description: Small boxed caption at the bottom (10 words max), e.g. "IT IS NOT YOUR DOG".

captionKeyword.description: Spoken word the caption lands on.

pose.description: Pose the protagonist takes on the stamp when there is no action (default point-up).

endAction.description: A second action near the end (e.g. run, hide, lights-out, visitor-at-door).

exampleNarration: If your dog ever hides under your bed at two in the morning, do not call for it. Get under there with it. And do not ask why.

name: Rule Card
description: A numbered RULE card: red RULE N tab, the rule in bold condensed type with its key word in red, a pictogram icon (object or cast member), crossed out with a red circle-slash when the rule is a DON'T, and optionally a figure beside it acting it out. Use for introducing or recapping each rule.

rule.description: The rule, 2-12 words, e.g. "NEVER *ANSWER* AFTER MIDNIGHT". Star the key word.

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

icon.description: Pictogram on the card: an object (door, phone, window, clock, bed, car, poster, key, mirror, tv, eye, hand, flashlight, bulb...) or a cast member (dog, visitor, kid...).

forbidden.description: Red circle-slash over the icon (a DON'T rule).

subtext.description: Small caption under the card (10 words max).

subtextKeyword.description: Spoken word the subtext lands on.

character.description: Optional figure beside the card acting out the rule.

pose.description: Pose the figure snaps into on the key word (e.g. stop, hush, cover-ears, scared, point, hide).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleProps.subtext: NO MATTER WHO IT SAYS IT IS

exampleNarration: Rule three. Do not answer the door after midnight. No matter who it says it is.

name: Do / Don't
description: Split screen: the correct action on one side (figure + object, black check) and the wrong one on the other (red X slams in with a red flash). Use for "do this, never that" beats and myth-busting.

title.description: Headline at the top, 6 words max.

text.description: Label under this side, 6 words max, e.g. "LOCK IT" / "OPEN IT".

keyword.description: Spoken word this side lands on.

object.description: Pictogram object next to the figure (door, phone, window, tv, car...).

action.description: Object animation on the key word.

text.description: Label under this side, 6 words max, e.g. "LOCK IT" / "OPEN IT".

keyword.description: Spoken word this side lands on.

object.description: Pictogram object next to the figure (door, phone, window, tv, car...).

action.description: Object animation on the key word.

doKeyword.description: Spoken word the check side lands on.

dontKeyword.description: Spoken word the X side lands on.

verdict.description: Final red stamp at the bottom, 5 words max.

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: When it knocks, you stay quiet. You never open it. Because it counts the seconds until you do.

name: Room At Night
description: Pure black room; a figure's flashlight cone sweeps across it and reveals one pictogram at a time (each with a small callout on its word), until the beam lands on a pair of white eyes and a smile in the dark. Use for the creepiest beats, searches and "what is in your room at 3 AM".

object.description: What the beam finds: an object of the room (bed, window, door, clock, lamp, tv, couch, fridge, mirror, bath, stairs, tree, car...) or any pictogram (poster, teddy, phone, footprints, eye, hand, box, key, crib...).

keyword.description: Spoken word this reveal lands on.

action.description: Something that happens as it is lit (door-opens, curtains-close, tv-static, clock-strikes...).

reveals.description: What the flashlight finds, in order (1-4).

visitor.description: Where the eyes appear at the end: door, window, corner, or none.

visitorKeyword.description: Spoken word the eyes appear on.

stamp.description: Final red stamp, 5 words max (e.g. "TURN IT *OFF*").

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

ambient.description: How much of the room leaks through outside the beam, 0-0.3 (default 0.08).

exampleNarration: Check the window. Check the clock. Check the door. And if something is standing there, turn it off.

name: Countdown Clock
description: A big digital time stamp ticks from one time to the next while the figure waits in the room (sitting up in bed by default); when it hits the target time, the event happens (lights flicker, knock, door opens, phone rings...) and the stamp slams in. Use for "at exactly 2:00 AM..." moments.

pose.description: How they wait: sit-bed (default in a bedroom), sit, stand, lie, sleep, listen, cover-ears...

event.description: What happens at the target time.

eventKeyword.description: Spoken word the clock reaches the target on (e.g. "exactly", "two").

stamp.description: Stamp after the event, 6 words max.

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

caption.description: Caption shown while the clock ticks (8 words max).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: Wait for it. At exactly two in the morning, something knocks on your bedroom door. Don't move.

name: Object Warning
description: One pictogram object huge in frame with a blinking warning triangle and up to four callouts with red arrows (each on its spoken word), then a red stamp and a ring around it. Use for "this is what to look for" beats: the poster, the phone, the door, the mirror.

objectKeyword.description: Spoken word the object pops in on.

title.description: Headline at the top, 6 words max.

dx.description: Where the arrow points on the object, -0.5 to 0.5 of its width (default alternates).

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: The poster has your dog's face on it. Your number. And it is dated tomorrow. Check the date.

name: Phone Screen
description: A big pictogram phone with a fake screen: an incoming call that vibrates (from UNKNOWN, MOM, YOUR OWN NUMBER...) or a chat where messages arrive one by one on their words, with a figure beside it reacting. Use for calls, texts and DO NOT ANSWER rules.

label.description: Small red label above the name (default INCOMING CALL).

ringKeyword.description: Spoken word the phone starts ringing / first message lands on.

me.description: Sent by the viewer (right side, red).

messages.description: For kind = message: 1-6 messages in order.

character.description: Figure beside the phone (default you; "none" for phone only).

pose.description: Pose the figure ends in (default cover-ears).

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

caption.description: Caption at the top before the ring (8 words max).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: Your mom is asleep upstairs. So when your mom calls you at two in the morning, do not answer.

name: Checklist Protocol
description: A numbered protocol list: each step slams in on its word with a pictogram icon, then gets a black check (or a red X for the step you must NOT do). Optional figure beside it performing each step. Use for the full rule list, recaps and survival steps.

title.description: Red title tab, 4 words max (e.g. "THE PROTOCOL").

done.description: false = red X instead of a check.

pose.description: Pose the figure takes for this step.

character.description: Figure beside the list acting out steps (landscape / square only).

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: Lock the door. Close the curtains. Unplug the phone. And do not look outside. Every night.

name: Stinger Reveal
description: A calm room with a build-up (knock, door opens, lights flicker...), lights dip, then a HARD CUT to black with the visitor's white eyes and too-wide smile filling the frame, red flash, shake and a stamp. Optionally cut back to the trembling cast. Use once or twice per video, on the scariest line.

before.description: Calm stamp before the cut (5 words max, disappears on the cut).

buildup.description: What happens just before the cut (default knock).

keyword.description: Spoken word the hard cut lands on (e.g. "looks", "smiling").

visitorPos.description: face = eyes and smile fill the frame (default); full = the whole tall figure reaching.

stamp.description: Stamp over the black, 4 words max (e.g. "*RUN*", "IT'S *INSIDE*").

hold.description: Seconds to hold on the visitor before cutting back (0 = stay until the end, default).

after.description: Stamp after cutting back (5 words max).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: You tell yourself it's just the wind. Then the knocking stops, and something in the hallway is smiling at you. It's inside. Get out.

name: Title Card
description: Chapter / rule opener: lights flicker on, a giant condensed headline slams in with its key word in red, a kicker tab (RULE 1, PART 2), an optional pictogram or cast member under it, a warning triangle and a number badge. Use for the intro and every chapter break.

title.description: Headline, 2-9 words, e.g. "IF YOUR DOG *HIDES* UNDER THE BED".

keyword.description: Spoken word the stamp slams on (default: the *starred* word in the stamp, else its longest word).

subtitle.description: Line under it, 10 words max (e.g. "GET UNDER THERE WITH IT").

kicker.description: Red tab above the title, e.g. "RULE 1", "PART 2", "WARNING".

number.description: Number badge in the corner (chapter / rule number).

icon.description: Pictogram under the title: an object or a cast member (dog, visitor, kid...).

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleProps.title: IF YOUR DOG *HIDES* UNDER THE BED
exampleProps.subtitle: GET UNDER THERE *WITH* IT

exampleNarration: Rule one. If your dog hides under the bed at two in the morning, get under there with it.

name: Outcome Split
description: "IF YOU DO X" split: one side shows what happens if you follow the rule (waving figure, calm), the other what happens if you don't (the visitor appears with a red flash and shake), then a tilted red verdict stamp. Use for consequences and "this is why".

condition.description: Top headline, 7 words max (e.g. "IF YOU *ANSWER* THE DOOR").

label.description: Side heading (default IF YOU DO / IF YOU DON'T).

keyword.description: Spoken word this side lands on.

character.description: Figure on this side (default you on the good side, visitor on the bad side).

good.description: Whether this outcome is good (default: first side good, second bad).

label.description: Side heading (default IF YOU DO / IF YOU DON'T).

keyword.description: Spoken word this side lands on.

character.description: Figure on this side (default you on the good side, visitor on the bad side).

good.description: Whether this outcome is good (default: first side good, second bad).

doKeyword.description: Spoken word the first side lands on.

dontKeyword.description: Spoken word the second side lands on.

verdict.description: Final tilted red stamp, 5 words max.

mode.description: Art mode: light = black silhouettes on white (default); dark = white silhouettes on black (night, dread).

exampleNarration: If you check the date, you stay home. If you don't, you go looking for the dog. And it is waiting.
